opening: Elizabeth Boyd Glasgow was born at Tamlaght on 9 September 1889 to Daniel Glasgow and Mary Jane formerly Boyd. The Boyd household and memorial identify her later life at high confidence.

position.answer: Elizabeth's birth and parents are documented; the Drimbolg memorial records her death on 4 January 1933 aged 43.

evidence_questions.title: How is the memorial niece identified?
evidence_questions.answer: Her distinctive full name, Tamlaght birth, mother formerly Boyd, 1901 niece relationship and memorial niece wording form a continuous maternal-family chain.
evidence_questions.reasoning: The original birth and census establish Elizabeth in Hugh Boyd's family; the memorial repeats her full name and niece relationship.
evidence_questions.limitation: The memorial is a transcription; no stone image or civil death entry was inspected.
evidence_questions.missing: An original death return could confirm place and informant but is not required for the current identity assessment.

birth-elizabeth-glasgow-1889.recorded_statement: Born 9 September 1889 at Tamlaght to Daniel Glasgow and Mary Jane formerly Boyd.
birth-elizabeth-glasgow-1889.limitation: None material to the registered date and parents.

census-tamlaght-1901.recorded_statement: Lizzie B. Glasgow, 11, was a niece of Hugh S. Boyd.
census-tamlaght-1901.limitation: The absent parents are not named on the form.

memorial-drimbolg-boyd.recorded_statement: Elizabeth Boyd Glasgow, niece of Hugh Scott and Joseph A. Boyd, died 4 January 1933 aged 43.
memorial-drimbolg-boyd.limitation: Published transcription rather than an inspected stone image or civil return.
